display_title: Subsidieprogramma Oekraïne partnerfaciliteit 2026 (UPF4) – Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)
executive_summary: Fourth round of the Ukraine Partnership Facility, a subsidy programme of the Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation run by RVO, for partnerships of companies and civil-society organisations (two to six partners, including at least one company seated in the Netherlands and one organisation established in Ukraine) that carry out reconstruction projects in Ukraine in healthcare, water, sustainable energy or agriculture and agrofood. The sustainable-energy strand seeks decentralised renewable generation, energy efficiency and energy storage; feasibility studies, pilots and experimental technologies are excluded. The subsidy is up to 90% of eligible costs, EUR 500,000 to EUR 4 million per project, from a EUR 26.5 million budget, handled first-come, first-served. A mandatory quick scan is due by 3 December 2026, 17:00; applications run from 4 March 2027, 10:00, to 8 April 2027, 17:00. Projects last 6 months to 4 years.
status_rationale: The programme (Staatscourant 2026, 35300, bijlage sections 1 and 4.4) funds non-commercial reconstruction projects in Ukraine, in the energy sector decentralised renewable generation, energy efficiency and storage with proven technologies for local use. It does not touch TenneT's field: the work takes place in and benefits only the Ukrainian energy system, excludes pilots and experimental technology, and would not plausibly benefit TenneT's Dutch grid; no project file is close. Both project dates are null because the call states only a start within two months of the grant decision and a duration of 6 months to 4 years.
